, Reason for Mistake: Misread the Hanggin Rear Banner figure “20.87万人” as 20.87 million instead of 208,700 (万 = 10,000), and also misreported Shanghai’s population by using the 14.8017 million household-registered number instead of the 24.8745 million permanent residents.
